catalog.nav.title: Products
catalog.fields.name: Name
catalog.page.noCategoryHint: Create a category first, then add products to it.
catalog.page.menuNumberHint: The dish number on your menu, e.g. 12 or 12a. Waiters can order by it.
catalog.page.menuNumberInvalid: Up to 6 letters, digits, dots or dashes.
catalog.page.fillNumbersDescription: Products without a number get the next free numbers, in menu order. Existing numbers stay.
catalog.page.archiveCategoryDescription: {name} is hidden from ordering. Its products stay as they are.
catalog.page.archiveProductDescription: {name} is hidden from ordering. Past orders keep it.
catalog.errors.categoryNameTaken: A category with this name already exists.
catalog.errors.productNameTaken: This category already has a product with this name.
catalog.errors.categoryArchived: This category is archived. Restore it or choose another one.
catalog.errors.priceInvalid: Some prices would be below 0 or too high. Nothing was changed.
catalog.errors.menuNumberTaken: Another product already has this number.
catalog.errors.priceRuleNotFound: This price rule no longer exists.
catalog.errors.priceRuleInvalid: Check the highlighted fields of the price rule.
catalog.errors.importInvalid: Some rows of the file have problems. Nothing was imported.
catalog.import.title: Import products from a CSV or Excel file
catalog.import.intro: One row per product with the columns category, name, price, tax_rate (VAT %) and optionally description. Products with the same category and name get the new price, VAT and description; missing categories are created.
catalog.import.problemsTitle: Fix these rows in the file, then choose it again:
catalog.import.fields.name: Name
catalog.import.problems.duplicate: this category and name appear twice in the file
catalog.import.problems.duplicateNumber: this number appears twice in the file
catalog.import.empty: The file has no product rows.
catalog.import.done: Done: {created} created · {updated} updated · {unchanged} unchanged · {categories} new categories.
catalog.import.unreadable: This file could not be read as an Excel workbook (.xlsx). Save it again from Excel, or as CSV.
catalog.prices.title: Price rules
catalog.prices.description: Prices per location, happy hours and promotions. The most specific rule wins; a time rule applies on top of the regular price.
catalog.prices.empty: No price rules yet. Products cost their own price everywhere.
catalog.prices.deleteDescription: Orders already sent keep their prices.
catalog.prices.name: Name
catalog.prices.hoursHint: Leave both empty for all day. An end before the start runs past midnight.
catalog.prices.problems.target: Choose a product or a category.
catalog.prices.problems.percentOnProduct: A percentage works on categories; give a product a fixed price.
catalog.prices.problems.value: Enter an amount like 4.50, or a percentage from 0.01 to 100.
catalog.prices.problems.hours: Give both times, and not the same.
catalog.prices.problems.dates: The end date is before the start date.
catalog.prices.problems.name: Enter a name.
catalog.prices.checkHint: What each product costs at a location at a given time.
catalog.scan.title: Scan a menu
catalog.scan.intro: Upload photos or a PDF of your menu. It is read on this device; nothing is sent until you import.
catalog.scan.drop: Drop menu photos or a PDF here
catalog.scan.formats: Any photo (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC…) or PDF · up to {max} photos, PDFs up to {pdf} pages · or paste with Ctrl+V
catalog.scan.firstUse: The first scan downloads the text recognition data (about 10 MB) once.
catalog.scan.errors.heic: HEIC photos can't be read here. Export them as JPG (iPhone: Settings › Camera › Formats › Most Compatible).
catalog.scan.errors.tooManyPages: At most {max} photos or scanned pages per scan, and PDFs up to {pdf} pages.
catalog.scan.errors.unreadable: A file could not be read.
catalog.scan.errors.ocr: Text recognition failed. Check your connection (the first scan downloads data) and try again.
catalog.scan.errors.nothing: No products with prices were found. Try a sharper, straight photo in good light.
catalog.scan.noOriginal: The original pages aren't kept after a reload.
catalog.scan.discardDescription: All products read and your changes are lost.
catalog.scan.done: Imported: {created} new · {updated} updated · {unchanged} unchanged · {categories} new categories
catalog.scan.dnd.instructions: To pick up an item, press Space or Enter. Use the arrow keys to move it, Space or Enter to drop it, Escape to cancel.
catalog.scan.ready: {count} file(s) ready. Click “Read menu” to start.
catalog.scan.errors.tooSmall: This picture is only {width} × {height} px, too small to read the menu text. Use the original photo or the full-size image (at least 1000 px wide).
catalog.scan.smallWarning: The picture is only {width} × {height} px, so this result is likely incomplete or wrong. For a good scan use the original photo or the full-size image (at least 1000 px wide).
catalog.scan.suggest.name: Did you mean “{name}”?
catalog.scan.checkHeading: Check this heading: it may be cut off or misread.
catalog.scan.exactPdf: Read from the PDF’s own text: names, descriptions and prices are exactly as printed.
catalog.bulk.priceValueInvalid: Enter a number like 1.50 (negative to subtract).
catalog.bulk.archiveDescription: They are hidden from ordering. Past orders keep them.
catalog.bulk.deleteProductsDescription: Products that were never sold are deleted for good. Sold ones are kept.
catalog.bulk.deleteCategoriesDescription: Their products are deleted with them, archived ones too. If one of a category's products was sold, that category and all its products stay.
catalog.bulk.keptTitle: Not deleted because they were sold: {names}
catalog.stations.hint: Where its items are prepared: each station gets its own ticket.
catalog.page.renumberDescription: Every active product gets 1, 2, 3 … in menu order (categories, then products), replacing its current number. Printed menus and what staff type at the till change.
catalog.page.dragHint: Drag categories by their handle to set the menu order. Renumber menu follows it.
catalog.categoriesPage.intro: Group your products. Drag a category to change the order everywhere it is listed.
catalog.errors.categoryParentInvalid: This category can't be a secondary category of that one. Pick a top-level category, and only for a category without secondary categories of its own.
catalog.errors.categoryImageInvalid: The image must be a WebP, PNG or JPEG file of at most 300 KB.
